Usage: resecta-data build calibrate temperature [OPTIONS]

  Fit the scalar doctype-softmax temperature T against a Swift dump.

Options:
  --softmax-dump FILE      Path to the Swift DocumentTypeClassifier softmax (logits) dump.
                           [required]
  --corpus FILE            Path to the G8 corpus the dump was produced against.  [required]
  --schemas-dir DIRECTORY  [default: schemas]
  --build-dir DIRECTORY    [required]
  --seed INTEGER           [default: 20260416]
  --help                   Show this message and exit.
